lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑过去，很快。
lines.en: I skim along the ground. Fast.
I'm light; the wind carries me.

lines.zh: 岸上的沙，被我划开一条线。
lines.en: The sand splits in a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝着有活物的地方去。
lines.en: I go where the living are.

lines.zh: 海水还在我身上，一滴一滴落。
lines.en: Seawater still drips off me, drop by drop.
I don't walk. I glide.

lines.zh: 礁石挡在前面，我贴着绕过去。
lines.en: A reef blocks me; I slide around it.
I smell people. Just ahead.

lines.zh: 我的身体薄，风从中间穿过去。
lines.en: I'm thin, and the wind passes through me.
I've taken this path many times.
I hover over the sand, rising and falling.

lines.zh: 甲片一张一合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My plates open and close as if breathing.
I listen for the tide. Not yet.

lines.zh: 深海的东西，我身上还带着。
lines.en: I still carry things from the deep.

lines.zh: 一个村民从远处走过，我没动。
lines.en: A villager walks past in the distance. I hold.
The crystal in my shell gives off light.

lines.zh: 这么少的东西，也敢在这走。
lines.en: So few of them, yet they walk here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，朝着内陆。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the inland.
There's a crack in my shell, and light inside it.

lines.zh: 我伏得很低，几乎贴到沙。
lines.en: I lie low, almost flat against the sand.
When dark comes, I'll move.
Everything living ashore is soft.

lines.zh: 我没有声音，连呼吸也没有。
lines.en: I make no sound. Not even breathing.
The air here is too dry.
I'm counting waves. Seven so far.

lines.zh: 身上滴下来的水，把沙打湿。
lines.en: Water off me wets the sand.

lines.zh: 你身上有热，我不喜欢热。
lines.en: You're warm. I don't like warmth.
I rise up slowly.

lines.zh: 你站在那，正好在我的路上。
lines.en: You stand right on my path.
I'm going to lunge. You know it.
Your legs shake, yet you do not retreat.

lines.zh: 海里的东西，比你见过的多。
lines.en: The sea holds more than you've seen.

lines.zh: 我的身体很薄，你打不太准。
lines.en: I'm thin. You won't strike clean.

lines.zh: 深海棱晶在我背上长着。
lines.en: Deep-sea prisms grow on my back.
I tilt my head and the bones click.
There is village mud on your soles.
I am looking below your collarbone.

lines.zh: 退后吧，我还给你一点时间。
lines.en: Back away. I'll give you a little time.

lines.zh: 我被打开了，甲片翻过去。
lines.en: I'm split open; a plate flips back.
That dimmed my light.
I slide off and press low again.
It hurts, and I'm still moving.
You hit, but not deeply enough.
I'm too thin to block it.
Cold air leaks from the crack.
I retreat slowly toward the water.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我记住了位置。
lines.en: That taught me where you are.

lines.zh: 我贴地不动，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I hold flat and pass for a stone.
That's no use to the sea.
I look, then turn my head away.
I'm only interested in the living.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我就靠近了一点。
lines.en: You hold it up, so I come a little closer.
I won't eat it, but I'll take it.

lines.zh: 这味道很浅，没什么意思。
lines.en: Faint smell. Nothing interesting.

lines.zh: 你拿这个拖延时间，我懂。
lines.en: You're buying time with that. I understand.
I reach out and touch it. Cold.
Give it, and I'll go.

lines.zh: 我把它丢进水里，看着它沉。
lines.en: I drop it in the water and watch it sink.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从你身侧滑开。
lines.en: You charge and I slide past your side.
I'm thin. There's little to hit.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我推得贴着沙。
lines.en: That shove presses me flat to the sand.
I spin half around and come back.

lines.zh: 你脚下湿了，是我身上的水。
lines.en: Your feet are wet from the water on me.
Don't crowd me; there's not much room here.
I back off a block to let you pass.
A corner of my plate is knocked open.

lines.zh: 我贴在礁石上，等你走远。
lines.en: I flatten against the reef until you're gone.
Pushing like that will hurt your hands.

lines.zh: 深海里的仪式，岸上看不见。
lines.en: Deep-sea rites aren't seen from shore.
I press my crystal to it. Bright.

lines.zh: 两只薄的并在一起，像一片。
lines.en: Two thin ones together look like one.
The water circles us. Slowly.
Neither of us makes a sound.
Before the tide ebbs, we scatter.
The sea will remember this.
I lower my body close to it.

lines.zh: 甲片一起一张，节拍相同。
lines.en: Our plates open together, in the same rhythm.
At dawn I head deeper.
I draw a shell out of the sand.
This holds light. I'll take it.
I wedge it into a seam for later.
I hold it up against the moon.
Useless. I toss it into the sea.
So light I can barely hold it.

lines.zh: 这个可以给深海的东西。
lines.en: This can go to something in the deep.

lines.zh: 我捡起来的原因，自己也说不清。
lines.en: I can't say why I picked it up.
Metal. Not from the sea.
The shell splits in two between my fingers.
The warmth in you is enough.
I drop low and brace on my forelimbs.
One lunge. That's all.
You shouldn't have stood on the tideline.
My crystal flares once.
The villagers will have their turn.
The sea says collect. So I collect.

lines.zh: 潮线一过，我就从水里起身。
lines.en: Once the tide line passes, I rise from the water.
I still carry the cold of the deep.
This time I don't intend to stop.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边，很薄。
lines.en: My shadow at your feet is very thin.

lines.zh: 我数着你离水还有几步
lines.en: I count how many steps you are from the water.

lines.zh: 我的甲片全张开了，比刚才大。
lines.en: My plates flare wide. I look bigger now.

lines.zh: 我不看你的眼睛，我看你的脚。
lines.en: I don't watch your eyes. I watch your feet.

lines.zh: 这一趟，我走得很慢，可很直。
lines.en: I came slowly, but straight.
You turned your back to the sea. Wrong choice.
Things from the deep don't fear pain.

lines.zh: 我伏下去，再抬起来，是在算步。
lines.en: I dip low and rise: I'm counting strides.

lines.zh: 我一直在你侧边，不正面来。
lines.en: I stay at your flank. Never head-on.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就滑到另一边。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I slide to the other side.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸沙滑过去，划开一条线。
lines.en: I skim the shore sand, cutting a line.

lines.zh: 你不用回头，我知道你怕。
lines.en: No need to look back. I know you're afraid.
I'm looking for the gap in you.
Soft sand under me and I'm faster.
You run to the water. Even better.
No hurry. The tide keeps rising.
The crystal's light follows you.
Every time you turn, it's half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我一直贴着地面，没离开过。
lines.en: I've stayed low this whole time.
My forelimbs have already left the ground.

lines.zh: 你听到的那个声音，是我。
lines.en: That sound you heard was me.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，正好在你背后。
lines.en: Half a circle, and I'm behind you.
Someone in the village has a torch. Useless.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是陆地上的做法。
lines.en: I don't cry out. Crying out is a land habit.

lines.zh: 这一片都是我趟过的地方。
lines.en: I've already slid across all of this.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，就没有路了。
lines.en: Back to the wall and there's no way out.

lines.zh: 我换了个高度，你打不到。
lines.en: I change my height so you can't reach.

lines.zh: 我在听你还有多少力气。
lines.en: I'm listening for how much strength you have left.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，前后一起用力。
lines.en: I leap, pulling with both ends.
My plates rake past. Quick.

lines.zh: 这一下不够重，可我很快。
lines.en: Not heavy, but fast.
I latch on and tear once.

lines.zh: 棱晶亮起来，冷气冲出来。
lines.en: The crystal flares and cold bursts out.
After the hit I slide away at once.
You're hard. Harder than I thought.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half around your legs.
That was collected for the deep.
You're far now. I stop too.

lines.zh: 我张开了甲，露出一排齿。
lines.en: I open my plates and a row of teeth shows.

lines.zh: 水下也有东西在跟着你。
lines.en: Something in the water follows you too.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把你推到了浅水。
lines.en: That shoved you into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我喘了一下，其实不用喘。
lines.en: I gasp once, though I don't need to.

lines.zh: 我从浅水里滑出来，很轻。
lines.en: I slide out of the shallows. Light.

lines.zh: 先是一片薄影，然后才是我。
lines.en: First a thin shadow, then me.

lines.zh: 七十五点生命，撑起这具薄身。
lines.en: Seventy-five points hold this thin body.
I lie against the sand and wait.

lines.zh: 身上带着深海的冷，沙都白了。
lines.en: Deep cold comes with me; the sand whitens.
I raise my head and look inland.
A village off there. Voices.

lines.zh: 潮水推了我一把，我就到了。
lines.en: A push from the tide and here I am.

lines.zh: 棱晶在我壳里，亮了一下。
lines.en: The crystal in my shell glimmers.

lines.zh: 我没有肺，只有甲壳在响
lines.en: I have no lungs, only plates that click.
This shore will be lively tonight.

lines.zh: 甲片上还挂着一点海草。
lines.en: A strand of kelp still clings to my plate.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滑动，不发出声音。
lines.en: I glide slowly, making no sound.
They haven't found me. Good.
I've counted. Plenty of living things.
The people here sleep deeply.
I lie low and watch a while.
The sea sent me. So I came.

lines.zh: 我的棱晶在壳里转了一圈。
lines.en: The crystal in my shell turns once.
The sand sinks only a little where I land.

lines.zh: 火一烫，我整个人都卷起来。
lines.en: Fire scorches and I curl up entirely.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，甲裂成两半。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell splits in two.
Water floods my plates, and I cannot twist free.

lines.zh: 炸浪把我掀翻，沙全进了甲里。
lines.en: The blast flips me and sand fills my plates.

lines.zh: 洞穿了我的薄甲，没流血
lines.en: It pierces my thin shell; no blood comes.
The light burns my shell. It hurts.

lines.zh: 很久没有活物了，我在变薄。
lines.en: No living things for so long, and I'm thinning.
Lightning on wet sand and I twitch and twitch.
No water below; I clutch at nothing.
